title: A map of links and dependencies
description: Labeled relationships between any nodes, which can be read apart from the tree.

blocks.text: Some thoughts belong to several subjects at once. Duplicating a node creates copies that drift apart instead of explaining the link.

quote.text: I was looking for a mind map app that showed for non hierarchical relationships (so not just parent-child) and that didn't require a subscription and this has proved to be excellent. App is very fast, and good for taking notes on books, timelines of history, plotting out systems.

blocks.text: Add cross-branch links with a name for the relationship and a way to show them selectively. Keep the endpoints and the labels when things are moved.
Start with a small set of relationships for a specific job. Too many lines make a map less clear, even when every one of them is correct.
